dimensions.name: Knowledge Delta
dimensions.justification: Provides concrete, expert‑level artifacts not commonly known: exact Fargate CPU/memory combo matrix, capacity‑provider weight/base strategy, recent 2024‑2026 feature list, and precise IAM trust policy snippets. This adds substantive new knowledge beyond a baseline model.

dimensions.name: Mindset + Appropriate Procedures
dimensions.justification: Encodes an AWS‑specific deployment workflow with ordered steps (task definition → roles → network → ALB → circuit breaker → autoscaling) and exact CLI syntax, reflecting senior CloudOps reasoning rather than generic "check security" advice.

dimensions.name: Anti-Pattern Quality
dimensions.justification: Contains a concrete NEVER list with explicit rationales (e.g., never use :latest, never combine execution and task roles, never target_type=instance). The list is limited to five items in‑line but references a fuller list; more exhaustive coverage would be ideal.

dimensions.name: Specification Compliance
dimensions.justification: Full frontmatter, clear description, explicit WHEN_TO_USE, triggers, keywords, and a strict output contract with literal labels. Activation criteria are well defined; only minor vagueness in “keywords” breadth.

dimensions.name: Progressive Disclosure
dimensions.justification: Uses layered sections: quick navigation, strict contract, reasoning, step‑by‑step procedure, matrix, NEVER, heuristics, edge cases, and deep references. Core checklist is concise; deeper details are deferred to reference files, avoiding overload.

dimensions.name: Freedom Calibration
dimensions.justification: Calibrates freedom appropriately: the skill only generates a checklist, never runs destructive AWS commands. Output constraints are tight, while the internal decision logic (e.g., capacity‑provider weighting) is sufficiently detailed for the task.

dimensions.name: Pattern Recognition
dimensions.justification: Follows a recognizable pattern (metadata → navigation → contract → reasoning → procedure → matrix → anti‑patterns → heuristics → edge cases → references). The structure is consistent and aids comprehension.

dimensions.name: Practical Usability
dimensions.justification: Model output examples conform exactly to the contract, correctly flag missing prerequisites, and include functional verification commands. Edge‑case handling (cross‑account ECR, Spot interruption, health‑check alignment) is addressed, making the skill readily usable.
